verdict.rationale: Composition Revisions give Crossplane its own versioning mechanism for automation logic ("Manage changes to Compositions with revisions"). Composition Functions can be rendered and tested offline before applying, which supports review. Packages can be built, updated and pushed as versioned artifacts, and a community member notes the YAML is easy to commit to source control. Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior revision, a documented review/approval workflow, and depth of the revision docs beyond a one-line mention.
